offering_description.value: Provides reservoir description, production enhancement and reservoir management services, plus proprietary perforating and reservoir testing products, to oil and gas producers. Analyzes rock and fluid samples in laboratories and deploys specialized equipment and engineering teams at well sites.

primary_products.value: perforating systems; reservoir fluid sampling tools; production enhancement chemicals

primary_services.value: reservoir description; reservoir management consulting; core and fluid laboratory analysis; well completion and production optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, including national oil companies

end_markets.value: oil and natural gas exploration and production

revenue_model.value: product sales: perforating systems and production chemicals sold to operators; service fees: reservoir analysis, laboratory testing and field services; project or contract: multi-well reservoir studies and production enhancement programs under contract
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in well and reservoir samples and data, sells analysis and field services to oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: makes perforating systems and testing tools, sold to operators and service companies

geography_served.value: global: operations in over fifty countries across major oil and gas producing regions

specialization.value: related lines: reservoir description, production enhancement and reservoir management, sharing oil and gas operator customers and technical expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: technical sales teams selling directly to oil and gas operators; own locations: laboratories and field offices in producing regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, workplace safety and export rules for explosive perforating products and chemicals
